changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla courses: cursos con su estado de flujo (extracción, revisión, publicación); el dueño puede ser nulo (Sin asignar). Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría courses_audit y el trigger courses_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Courses created by instructors; the status drives the extraction, review and publication flow

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: owner_user_id
column.remarks: Instructor that owns the course; null means unassigned

column.name: status
column.remarks: Course status: draft, extracting, extraction_failed, in_review, generating_content, published or archived

column.name: extraction_error_code
column.remarks: Error code of the last failed syllabus extraction

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE courses ADD CONSTRAINT courses_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'extracting', 'extraction_failed', 'in_review', 'generating_content', 'published', 'archived'))
CREATE TRIGGER courses_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON courses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in courses

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE courses_audit ADD CONSTRAINT courses_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER courses_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON courses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS courses_audit_trg ON courses
